agents.name: Dataset Agent
agents.responsibility: loaded the selected dataset and resolved the prediction target

agents.name: EDA Agent
agents.responsibility: derived valid features and dataset type from the fresh in-memory profile

agents.name: Cleaning Agent
agents.responsibility: applied EDA-driven drops, target validation, sorting, missing-value handling, outlier capping, and split safety checks

agents.name: Feature Agent
agents.responsibility: created model-ready numeric, encoded, temporal, and optional text/PCA feature plan

agents.name: Training Agent
agents.responsibility: selected and trained RandomForest using EDA strategy and validation feedback

agents.name: Evaluation Agent
agents.responsibility: computed MAE, RMSE, MAPE, R2, and MASE on holdout data

agents.name: Deployment Agent
agents.responsibility: packaged run metadata, metrics, and monitor handoff information
